1556-2645-2930-3430.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2645-2930-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

277-5531-5694-5913-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-5531-5694-5913-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Pinnacle Monk and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-5531-5694-5913-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Pinnacle Monk and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4695-6734-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1308-4772-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-4742-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-4742-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1017-4866-4893-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1017-4866-4893-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2043-2099-3621.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

546-1409-4613-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least 5 total creatures on the battlefield.
546-1409-4613-7235.description:
Activate Stag Beetle by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Stag Beetle enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Stag Beetle enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Stag Beetle.
Activate Stag Beetle using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-2034-2557-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-2557-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

3373-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3373-5944.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

147-780-2511.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

3991-5231-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

3240-4050-5632.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

372-3603-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3603-5913.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1525-1974-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Gargantuan is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-1974-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-1974-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

2744-4762-5189.notablePrerequisites:
Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2744-4762-5189.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

282-505-1379-1558.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
282-505-1379-1558.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Izoni with haste.
When the Izoni token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Izoni token and the Insect tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1294-2167-4423-4426-5122.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-4423-4426-5122.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Caves' second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a basic Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Cryptic Caves from your graveyard.
Repeat.

618-1173-2160-2239.manaNeeded: {R}{R} on your first turn, with {1}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
618-1173-2160-2239.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Final Fortune from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

570-1692-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
570-1692-2011.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Faeburrow Elder with haste.
Activate the Faeburrow Elder token by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
